results.title: Addition
results.overview: Grace Lisa Vandenburg counts everything - the letters in her name, the poppy seeds on her orange cake. She counts because numbers hold the world together. But when a chance encounter with Seamus turns her world upside down, Grace's meticulously ordered life starts to unravel.

results.title: A Man of Vision: The Bill Wittliff Story
results.original_title: A Man of Vision: The Bill Wittliff Story
results.overview: From a small-town Texas boy to the visionary behind Lonesome Dove, Bill Wittliff spent a lifetime capturing the soul of Texas through photography, film, and storytelling.

results.title: Karaoke Murder
results.overview: One night, Mrs. Thuy’s ear-splitting karaoke pushes the entire neighborhood to the brink of insanity. But when she is suddenly murdered during a mountain pilgrimage, everyone becomes a suspect. Enter Tam - a young woman with a shady past - who is forced to take matters into her own hands. A rollercoaster of clues and tragicomic situations soon exposes the town's hidden secrets, from blind superstitions and bitter grudges to hilariously conflicting testimonies. As the elusive killer prepares to strike again, Tam must race against time to unmask the culprit before she becomes the next victim.

results.title: Written In Blood
results.overview: When Selena's family is wrongfully executed by the Mexican Cartel, she wages a violent war against their leader, Lucas Almonte. She forms an unexpected alliance with Nuevo Laredo Police Detective Alex, who has her own demons to face.

results.title: As the Hydra Devours History
results.original_title: Habang Nilalamon ng Hydra ang Kasaysayan
results.overview: Four Filipinos confront the slow erasure of memory and truth in a country devoured by disinformation.

results.title: The Children of Kozara
results.overview: Based on the novel of Arsen Diklić which describes the horrors of concentration camp Jasenovac.

results.title: NFT: Cursed Images
results.overview: A group of crypto savvy friends begin experiencing strange occurrences after buying into a cursed NFT collection.

results.title: Bidadari Surga
results.overview: Taufan, a wealthy and famous YouTuber known for his controversial content, suddenly falls in love with Nadia, the devout and principled daughter of a religious leader (kiai), who adamantly rejects Taufan's request to remove her hijab for a video. Rather than being repulsed, Nadia's assertiveness intrigues Taufan, encouraging him to seriously pursue her despite their vastly different backgrounds. In an effort to win Nadia's heart and her father's blessing, Taufan embarks on an unexpected journey.

results.title: Night Light
results.overview: Five days before the proclamation of Martial Law, the Colgante Bridge collapsed in Naga, forcing a father into a desperate search for his missing son.

results.title: Crystal of Happiness
results.overview: After the death of her husband, Şerife intends to live out her seventies as she sees fit. But her children, annoyed by her new behavior and friends, try to bring her back into line.

results.title: Fate
results.overview: The story takes place at a tourist resort in Hurghada, where a wealthy widow inherits the resort following the death of her billionaire husband. While managing the resort, she goes through several romantic experiences in search of a suitable life partner, until she meets a man with whom she falls in love.

results.title: The Four Gates of Death
results.overview: A graveyard rendezvous that isn’t just about love, but about fulfilling a promise – and facing its consequences.  A family weekend that digs up buried secrets – secrets that perhaps should have stayed underground forever.  A legendary VHS tape, worth killing for – or maybe someone already has.  And a childhood tale that proves, years later: sometimes the scariest things are the ones we believed were true as kids.  From Horrorszkóp and Cruel World Team comes four dark and unsettling stories in this chilling horror anthology.  Each one steeped in the shadow of death, human weakness, and the grim truth that the ending is never what you expect.  Four stories. Four secrets. Four inevitable ends.

results.title: Street Wanderers
results.overview: In 2010, two rival Chinese mafia groups wage a hidden war within a silent, fearful immigrant community. As merchants are extorted and women are trafficked, a small family restaurant becomes the unlikely epicentre of the conflict. With the help of Officer Li and wiretaps in Cantonese, prosecutor Diana Belenguer launches a groundbreaking investigation. But when Xu, a mafia soldier, defies his clan to save a young victim, he becomes a target – hunted by his own brother. What begins as a wiretap case spirals into a high-stakes chase through Argentina’s criminal underworld.

results.title: Wendy
results.overview: What if Neverland was all in Wendy's imagination? She gazes at the birds flying and wishes she could too. She meets and makes fast friends with a mysterious boy who shares her affinity for adventure. A stick becomes a sword, a sheet becomes a sail, and a cynical old farmer with a hooked cane becomes a pirate.

results.title: Bloodline
results.overview: An ancient curse with roots in Egypt resurfaces in a mysterious Istanbul mansion. Summoned to the estate by his dying grandfather, Can and his friends are soon forced to confront the mansion's dark secrets and a supernatural threat.

results.title: Double Shift Dad
results.overview: Forced to work a double shift on his daughter's birthday, a night watchman throws a secret party at his job. But what begins as a heartfelt gesture soon spirals out of control, putting his job and his relationship with her at risk.

results.title: SAYANG
results.overview: Nancy, an Indian-descended mother, returns to her hometown and opens a sign language school while caring for her son Ajay, who lives with both hearing impairment and a neurological condition. Among her students are Mina, a Malay girl determined to become a Muay Thai boxer despite cultural expectations, and Sansan, a Chinese girl deeply bound to the ocean she loves. Along the vast coastline, three families and three children navigate faith, identity, and freedom, until their intertwined lives become a moving symphony of resilience and love.

results.title: Trial of Hein
results.overview: After 14 years away, Hein returns to his home village on a remote island, only to discover that the close-knit community no longer recognises him. Suspecting him to be an impostor, they demand a trial to determine his true identity.
